steps.en: Start a self-hosted instance (or sign up for Langfuse Cloud)
steps.zh: 起一个自托管实例（或注册 Langfuse Cloud）

steps.en: Create a project and API keys, and put them in your app's environment
steps.zh: 建项目、生成 API key，放进应用的环境变量

steps.en: Decorate your functions and swap in the wrapped OpenAI client
steps.zh: 给函数加装饰器，换上包装过的 OpenAI 客户端

steps.en: Sends each request's nested calls, with prompts, outputs and model parameters, as one trace
steps.zh: 把每个请求里嵌套的调用连同提示词、输出、模型参数作为一条轨迹发出

steps.en: Processes events asynchronously and stores traces in ClickHouse
steps.zh: 异步处理事件，把轨迹写进 ClickHouse

steps.en: Shows each request as a trace tree you can search, with sessions, latency and cost
steps.zh: 把每个请求展示成可搜索的调用树，附带会话、耗时和费用

value.en: A bad answer can be traced to the exact retrieval, prompt version and model call that caused it, instead of guessed from a final log line
value.zh: 一个坏回答能追到具体是哪次检索、哪个提示词版本、哪次模型调用导致的，而不是对着最后一行日志猜

sources: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse#-quickstart (API credentials; LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY / LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY / LANGFUSE_BASE_URL; @observe(); from langfuse.openai import openai)
https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/releases/tag/v3.0.0 (worker container processes events asynchronously; ClickHouse stores traces, observations, scores)
